newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal and European Union to resume fishing talks.
newsitem.headline: Senegal and European Union to resume fishing talks.

text.p: Senegal and the European Union (EU) will resume talks over fishing rights on Sunday following their failure to reach agreement five months ago, Senegalese officials said.
"The talks with the European Union are set for March 23 till March 25," one told Reuters.
Last November, Senegal and the European Union failed to agree on conditions for renewning their two-year fishing agreement.
The Senegalese authorities were demanding a payment of 18 million ECUs to allow the European Union to fish in its waters. The EU offered only 10 million ECUs as compensation.
The European Union gave Senegal 31.2 million ECUs for 1992-94 and 15.8 millions ECUs for 1994-96.
